description: Copies a selected ChatGPT video attachment up to 128 MiB into the connected DubSync account. Ask permission to upload this file first and use the exact file handle supplied by ChatGPT. If either handle field is missing or the link is unsupported or expired, ask the user to reattach the file or upload it in DubSync. Import prepares the source without starting translation. If preparing is true, use the returned assetId and completionKey with dub_complete_upload. Supports known-length downloads from OpenAI-owned oaiusercontent.com hosts.

download_url.description: The exact temporary download URL supplied by ChatGPT for the selected attachment.

file_id.description: The exact ChatGPT file identifier supplied for the selected attachment.

idempotencyKey.description: A stable unique key for this operation. Reuse it with the exact same input after a timeout; never generate a new key to retry.

uploadConfirmed.description: True only after the user authorizes copying this specific file into their DubSync account. This is not translation consent.

name: dub_import_file

data.description: The safe public API response, or resumable-upload status.

title: Import a ChatGPT video file
